# Shrub: two jittered, flattened icospheres. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name ShrubA --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.30 --location 0 0 0.18
scale 1 1 0.7
material new Leaf --base-color 0.533 0.486 0.337
add mesh ico-sphere --name ShrubB --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0.25 0.12 0.14
scale 1 1 0.7
material assign Leaf
select all
apply
join
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 11
mode object
shade flat
export shrub.glb
